en.title: 8th Science Exploration Award Presented in Shenzhen, First Post-95s Winner Emerged
en.summary: The 8th Science Exploration Award ceremony took place in Shenzhen on September 20, with 50 young scientists receiving the honor. The award list included its first recipient born after 1995 and reached double-digit female awardees for the first time.

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: China Swimming Team Wins Six Golds on Opening Day, Chinese Delegation Accumulates Multiple Medals
en.summary: On the first competition day of the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games following the opening ceremony, 31 gold medals were awarded. China's sports delegation earned 11 gold medals total, with the swimming team securing 6 of them.

en.summary: The China-ASEAN Expo facilitates enhanced regional economic and trade cooperation, transitioning from mutual benefit sharing to win-win outcomes.

en.summary: The Asia-Pacific Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Dialogue Conference was held in Guangzhou on September 20, during which the Asia-Pacific Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Cooperation Partner Plan was unveiled in the Nansha District.

en.title: China-Europe Young Leaders Dialogue Held in Zhejiang
en.summary: A China-Europe Young Leaders Dialogue took place in Hangzhou on September 20 as part of a 2026 leadership training program. Over 30 young parliamentarians, officials, and organizational leaders from 11 European countries engaged in discussions with Chinese youth on technology collaboration and trade cooperation.

en.title: Heavy Rainfall Causes Landslides in Multiple Thai Regions
en.summary: Thailand experienced heavy rainfall and localized severe storms on September 20 due to a combination of high pressure systems, monsoon troughs, and strong southwest monsoons. Multiple landslides were reported across the country as a result of the severe weather conditions.

stories.title: 专家在上海解读《威克岛战俘》背后的中美民间情谊

en.title: Experts Discuss Sino-American Civilian Friendship Behind "Wake Island Prisoners of War" in Shanghai
en.summary: A seminar in Shanghai on September 20 examined the Chinese edition publication of a book about World War II prisoners of war. Scholars discussed the historical civilian mutual assistance between China and the United States during wartime and the role of civilian narratives in bridging cultural understanding.

en.summary: The fifth Global Digital Trade Expo opened its main exhibition hall on September 20 in Hangzhou, featuring advanced technologies including pharmacy robots, intelligent flight simulation systems, and robotic arms. Exhibitors from multiple countries participated in the showcase of digital trade innovations.

en.summary: Silk Road cultural heritage is experiencing integration and renewal in Rishtан, Uzbekistan's renowned pottery center, according to reporting from the location on September 20.

en.summary: A themed publicity campaign delegation visited the site of Inner Mongolia's autonomous government establishment meeting in Ulanhaote on September 19 to reflect on China's ethnic regional autonomy system's implementation.

en.title: China's CXMT touts new chip manufacturing platform as close to 'world's most advanced'
en.summary: Chinese memory chip manufacturer CXMT announced it has begun mass production using its new G5 technology platform, which significantly increases storage density and output per wafer compared to its previous generation, potentially narrowing the gap with leading global competitors Samsung and SK Hynix.

en.title: Housing prices surge near new Huanggang Port as buyers eye 'dual-city' lifestyle
en.summary: Property prices near the new Huanggang Port are rising ahead of its expected opening before year-end, as buyers seek a dual-city lifestyle between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. The border crossing will feature 24-hour operations and streamlined clearance procedures.

stories.title: Will fresh incentives give China’s housing market more than a short-lived rebound?

en.title: Will fresh incentives give China's housing market more than a short-lived rebound?
en.summary: Beijing's recent policy shift to revive China's real estate market has generated increased buyer interest in major cities. Property brokers report higher inquiry volumes and are optimistic about sales momentum, though some remain uncertain whether additional government stimulus will be needed to sustain the recovery.

en.title: Focused ultrasound could be the next big cancer breakthrough for hard-to-treat tumours
en.summary: Researchers are testing focused ultrasound technology as a potential treatment for pancreatic cancer and glioblastoma, with experts suggesting significant advances in treating these difficult cancers could emerge within years.
